findings: For an old edge k different from j and j-1, the proof derives that old j is neither endpoint of k. Parent G1 therefore excludes P j from the actual closed edge segment. At epsilon=0 the soft segment is the singleton P j, so the two closed segments are disjoint.

The canonical disjoint_segments_persist theorem uses closedness of the intersection configurations, obtained by projecting a closed set over the compact unit parameter square. It allows the soft direction to be zero at the limit and has no determinant-independence premise. Thus compact disjointness is used correctly for this degenerate limit.

A finite intersection over every old edge supplies one neighborhood for all nonincident old edges. The actual unchanged-edge formulas identify these segments with the enlarged tuple; no endpoint-only identification is substituted for segment equality.

The final positive radius is the minimum of the disjointness radius and the derived enlarged-G1 radius. Canonical successive-edge intersection applied to the actual incoming/soft and soft/return labels gives exactly {P j} and {P j+epsilon*q}, respectively. Enlarged G1 is proved from parent G1 and SoftAdmissible, not supplied as a caller assumption.

The universal exclusion quantifies over every enlarged edge except the soft, incoming and return labels. Exhaustive old/new classification eliminates the new label and reduces every old label to the established finite disjointness statement. All physical labels, arbitrary attachment j, cyclic wrapping and n=3 are retained.

The source generic-parent domain is included by the weaker parent-G1 hypothesis. No independence condition for a disjoint pair, root restriction, assumed contact classification or unproved global soft-family assertion enters the proof.
limits: This establishes precisely the soft segment contacts. It does not classify the return edge against other edges, prove G2 or chamber membership, or establish inherited/newborn crossing order and Gauss words. Stronger fidelity approval and canonical integration remain pending. Hash and kernel checks do not establish source acceptance.
